title: Aquaman Annual #2 DC 1996 Legends of the Dead Earth Peter David

descriptionText:
Aquaman Annual #2 (1996), DC Comics - Legends of the Dead Earth. Peter David story, Ed Hannigan and Mitchell. Direct sales, $2.95 cover price.
